ground_game.front: printed ramp, lip 0.6 mm off the floor, 1 mm thick at the edge: contests an opponent lip at 0.3-0.5 mm and deflects a rising tooth up its face instead of taking it square
ground_game.skirts: low ramped skirt round the sides and rear, 0.5 mm off the floor and protruding 3 mm, so no bearing has a door under the belly; its outer face slopes up 40 deg so a rising tooth glances off
ground_game.trade: against an opposing wedge, the lower lip wins: ours sits at 0.5-0.6 mm, a flexible acetate or TPU lip can sit on the floor and beat a rigid one; forks win by mass (more reach per gram) but leave tine gaps an opposing fork can enter, so the gaps are kept under the opponent's fork width or covered by the weapon

margins.why: relaxed: the outline is too small for 8 mm round the ESC/receiver and 10 mm round the battery's sides; battery keeps 10 mm front / 8 mm sides+rear, ESC and receiver sit against the inner wall (CF-GD04 accepted)
